text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval for the amendment of the parking regulations on Nashville Avenue, between Keele Street and Bicknell Avenue. The local Councillor has requested the amendment of the current 1-hour alternate north and south side parking to an alternate side 3-hour maximum parking to allow longer duration parking on Nashville Avenue.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking limit in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. from the 16th day of each month to the last day of each month, April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the north side of Nashville Avenue, between Bicknell Avenue and Keele Street. 2. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking limit in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. from the 1st day of each month to the 15th day of each month, April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the south side of Nashville Avenue, between Bicknell Avenue and Keele Street. 3. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking limit in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. from December 1 of one year to March 31 of the following year, inclusive, on the south side of Nashville Avenue, between Bicknell Avenue.
